payload.core_composition_summary: Linear scan with hash map lookups and binary search to check partition constraints using precomputed RMQ and suffix max.
payload.rationale: Solution uses hash maps for index storage and suffix max tracking, and binary search to locate candidate partition boundaries. Sparse table RMQ is used but not among candidate subtypes; closest subtypes cover hash map and binary search.
